name: Shanghaied Egg Noodle Stir-Fry with Cashews & Vegetables (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Soft egg noodles are tossed with whole roasted cashews, fibrous cabbage, bell peppers, snow peas, and chili-garlic soy sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If craving noodles, ask the kitchen for plain egg noodles tossed with soy sauce and shredded chicken only (no cashews, no stir-fry vegetables).
watchOuts: Cabbage, snow pea, and pepper roughage
